tw: Kron's fitness class: he sits, knits and fits six biscuits in his mitts.
twc: Kron 的健身课：坐着、织毛线，手套里塞了六块饼干。

tw: At soccer, Kron kicks his sock instead, and it knocks the clock off.
twc: 踢足球时，Kron 把袜子踢飞了，袜子把大钟撞了下来。

tw: Kron stays all day in the big stadium and plays a drum for one grey pigeon.
twc: Kron 在大体育场待了一整天，给一只灰鸽子打鼓。
hint: 体育场满座？满了一只鸽。

tw: After the marathon, Kron lies flat while a parrot eats the carrot on his tummy.
twc: 跑完马拉松，Kron 躺平，一只鹦鹉在他肚子上吃胡萝卜。

tw: Kron calls "Come along!" and a long line of ducks bangs a gong behind him.
twc: Kron 一喊“跟上！”，身后一长队鸭子敲起了锣。

tw: On one ski, Kron sips tea from his knee and flees three bees.
twc: Kron 踩一只滑雪板，膝上端着茶喝，身后三只蜜蜂在追。

tw: At track and field, Kron's black yak sits back and eats the field.
twc: 田径赛上，Kron 的黑牦牛往后一坐，把场地的草吃了。

tw: Kron's gymnastics get nasty when he lands in Jim's big bowl of snacks.
twc: Kron 的体操动作翻车了，一屁股落进吉姆的大碗零食里。

tw: Kron jogs in the heat till his wet sweat fills his pet fish's bowl.
twc: Kron 在大热天慢跑，湿漉漉的汗把宠物鱼的鱼缸都灌满了。

tw: Kron will make it over the lake on a cake, till a duck takes a bite.
twc: Kron 坐着蛋糕要划过湖去，直到一只鸭子咬了一口。
hint: 能成功，要看鸭子饿不饿。

tw: Kron becomes a legend by standing on one leg on a giant egg.
twc: Kron 单腿站在一颗巨蛋上，成了传奇。

tw: To set an example, Kron pitches a tent, and an elephant tramples the camp.
twc: 为了树立榜样，Kron 搭了顶帐篷，结果一头大象把营地踩平了。

tw: Kron rides to glory on a lorry while four doors fall off behind him.
twc: Kron 站在卡车上奔向荣耀，身后四扇车门哗啦啦掉下来。

tw: Kron the champ wins the jam pie championship on a sinking ship.
twc: 冠军 Kron 在一艘下沉的船上赢了果酱派锦标赛。

tw: With determination, Kron turns and pushes a whole train into the station.
twc: Kron 下定决心，转身把一整列火车推进了车站。
hint: 决心够大，火车也推得动。

tw: Kron's tall art cart starts to fall apart, so he calls it smart art.
twc: Kron 的高高艺术推车开始散架，他就说这是聪明的艺术。

tw: Kron reaches into the ginger tin, and the lid tries to injure his finger.
twc: Kron 把手伸进姜饼罐，盖子差点夹伤他的手指。

tw: Injured Kron rejects an inch of tape and points to the ginger nurse's giant roll.
twc: 受伤的 Kron 嫌弃一小截胶布，指着橘猫护士的超大纱布卷。
hint: 伤口一点点，绷带要最大。

tw: Kron shows the jury his injury in a hurry: one tiny pink plaster.
twc: Kron 急匆匆给陪审团看他的伤：一张小小的粉色创可贴。

tw: After a long trip, Captain Kron naps flat on the map under his cap.
twc: 长途航行后，Kron 船长趴在地图上，盖着帽子睡着了。
